records.title: When Models Hesitate: Answer Instability as a Label-Free Uncertainty Signal for LLMs
records.reason: This study evaluates answer instability as an uncertainty signal and selective-prediction aid; it does not propose an inference, serving, or compression optimization.

records.title: Thesis Proposal: Efficient KV Cache Reuse for Multi-Document Retrieval-Augmented Generation
records.reason: It proposes future work and does not provide a completed method or empirical efficiency validation; evidence is insufficient for a result-focused survey entry.

records.title: Layer-aware Dual-directional Modulation for Low-resource Machine Translation
records.reason: The contribution is a low-resource machine-translation adaptation method, not a method for improving LLM inference or serving efficiency.

records.title: CoTrust: Privacy-Preserving Collaboration Between Large and Small Language Models in Trusted Execution Environments
records.reason: The primary contribution is privacy isolation and collaboration; the checked evidence does not establish a survey-relevant efficiency gain or quantify its trade-off against enclave and communication overhead.

records.title: Privacy Risks of Intermediate Representations: Attribute Inference in Distributed LLM Inference
records.reason: The paper studies privacy attacks on intermediate representations in distributed inference; its stated contribution is threat measurement rather than an efficiency improvement.
